audience: Tutoring and education centres that manage students, parents and sessions in Oases

useCases.title: Look up a student or parent record
useCases.text: Read one student or parent record by id, then read the notes on that record.

useCases.title: Check invoices and payments
useCases.text: Read one invoice with its line items, and one payment record by id.

useCases.title: Read the reference lists
useCases.text: Read a reference list, such as states, schools, grades or session types, before you change a field.

useCases.title: Add a note to a student, parent or tutor
useCases.text: Add a note to a record. Each run creates a new note, so read the existing notes first.

useCases.title: Update one student or parent field
useCases.text: Change one field of a student or parent record. The server never deletes records.
